headline: All the news about the iPhone Duo
summary: Apple officially unveiled its long-anticipated foldable device, the iPhone Duo. It features a 5.4-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch inner screen with minimal crease. The new phone uses Touch ID on the power button and includes two cameras.

headline: Apple's updated App Store rules go after 'nudify' AI apps
summary: Apple's App Store rules now explicitly prohibit 'nudify' AI apps that generate nonconsensual intimate images. This update follows significant criticism after AI-generated deepfakes emerged earlier this year. Apple faced scrutiny but did not remove X or Grok from the App Store.

headline: We can finally hear some of Wu-Tang Clan's Once Upon A Time in Shaolin album
summary: Snippets of Wu-Tang Clan's elusive 'Once Upon A Time in Shaolin' album are now publicly accessible. The podcast 'Pablo Torre Finds Out' released two portions of the exclusive record. This album has been notoriously difficult for the public to hear for years.

headline: Tesla driver says he was asleep and using FSD when he crashed into highway patrol cars
summary: A Tesla driver reported being asleep and using Full Self-Driving during a crash involving highway patrol cars. California Highway Patrol warns that FSD is not fully autonomous despite its name. Drivers remain responsible for safely operating their vehicles at all times.

headline: Red Rising Greenlit for Movie Adaptation With Author Pierce Brown to Produce
summary: The 'Red Rising' book series by Pierce Brown has officially been greenlit for a movie adaptation. Paramount Pictures is producing the film. Francis Lawrence, director of 'The Hunger Games,' is set to helm the project.

headline: James Gunn Shoots Down Milly Alcock Supergirl Rumors, Shares Man of Tomorrow Update
summary: James Gunn dispelled rumors regarding Milly Alcock's alleged firing as Supergirl. He confirmed plans to show an early cut of 'Man of Tomorrow' to Peter Safran today. Gunn continues to provide updates on various DC universe projects.

headline: Super Smash Bros. Player Mew2King Banned From Tournament After Bug Bites Spark Health Concerns
summary: Professional Super Smash Bros. player Jason 'Mew2King' Zimmerman has been banned from a competitive tournament. The ban follows his social media posts showing a concerning skin condition and a home bug infestation. Health and safety concerns prompted the tournament organizers' decision.

headline: Street Fighter: How Can There Be an Ending Explained When There Is No Ending?
summary: The article explores the 'non-ending' of the new 'Street Fighter' movie, which is currently in theaters. It discusses how the film concludes without a definitive resolution. The piece also confirms whether there are any post-credits scenes.

headline: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
summary: The US president temporarily suspended several sanctions against Moscow. These restrictions were recently enacted by Congress. The decision comes amidst escalating tensions with Zelensky and over 'national security' concerns.

headline: Oregon teacher fought school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
summary: An Oregon teacher confronted a school attacker before an armed parent intervened. The father shot the 16-year-old suspect multiple times. Police stated the suspect, a former student, targeted a special educational needs classroom.

headline: Third runway at Heathrow Airport would drive growth, Healey says
summary: Healey argues that a third runway at Heathrow Airport would significantly boost economic growth. This statement follows the prime minister's refusal to publicly back the expansion. The debate surrounding Heathrow's future expansion continues.

headline: Analysis: Zacharia was thrown into a whirlwind - and failed at a critical time for Trump
summary: BBC's Anthony Zurcher analyzes Zacharia's performance, suggesting he faltered during a crucial period for Trump. The White House is currently facing mounting adversity. This comes just weeks before important midterm elections.
